settings.text: Everything about how your LUMA order gets to you — and our no-stress returns.

Order processing

Orders are processed within 1–2 business days (Monday–Friday, excluding holidays). You'll receive a confirmation email as soon as your order ships, with a tracking link.

Shipping rates & delivery

  • Free standard shipping on all orders over $50.
  • Orders under $50: a flat $4.95 standard rate.
  • Standard delivery: 3–6 business days.
  • Express delivery: 1–3 business days (calculated at checkout).

Delivery times are estimates from the date of dispatch and may vary during sales or holiday periods.

International shipping

We ship worldwide. International delivery typically takes 7–14 business days. Any customs duties or import taxes are the responsibility of the recipient and are not included at checkout.

Tracking your order

Once shipped, you'll get a tracking number by email. If you have an account, you can also track your order from your account page. Allow up to 48 hours for tracking to update.

Our 30-day glow guarantee

We want you to love your ritual. If you're not completely satisfied, you can return your items within 30 days of delivery for a full refund — even if they're opened. Skincare is personal, and we get it.

How to start a return

  • Email hello@luma.com with your order number and the items you'd like to return.
  • We'll send you a prepaid return label and simple instructions.
  • Pack the items securely (original packaging preferred but not required).
  • Drop off your parcel using the label provided.

Refunds

Once we receive your return, refunds are processed within 3–5 business days to your original payment method. You'll get an email confirmation when it's done. Original shipping charges are non-refundable unless the return is due to our error.

Exchanges

Want a different product instead? Start a return for a refund and place a new order — it's the fastest way to get what you really want.

Damaged or incorrect items

If anything arrives damaged, faulty, or incorrect, email us within 7 days at hello@luma.com with a photo and your order number. We'll make it right with a replacement or full refund — no return shipping needed.

Still have questions?

Our glow team is happy to help. Reach us any time at hello@luma.com and we'll reply within 24 hours (Mon–Fri).
